profile.title: Synthetic capillary interstitium to receptor-ligand hand-off

validity.description: Synthetic M4 exchange amount and represented volume selected to reproduce the independently verified M5.1 constant-reservoir concentration and binding result.

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M4.5 balanced capillary substance exchange
MEHLISSA Next M5.1 analytical receptor-ligand baseline
sources.role: target ligand concentration, exposure, and analytical response

sources.citation: Wendt, Regine (2024), Einsatz von Nanotechnologien in der Praezisionsmedizin, Sections 4.4-4.5, pp. 129-132
sources.role: capillary, molecular-detection, and cell-layer coupling concept

limitations: All substance amounts, compartment volumes, exposure times, kinetics, and thresholds are synthetic software-test parameters.
The complete accumulated interstitium inventory is assumed homogeneous within the represented volume.
The snapshot is non-consuming: receptor binding does not deplete or otherwise change the capillary tissue inventory.
The snapshot concentration is held constant for the configured exposure duration and has no transport feedback or temporal trajectory.
The oxygen-to-synthetic-ligand mapping verifies identifiers and units only and has no biological interpretation.
The target receptor model is stateless; the hand-off returns a response but does not yet persist cell state or notify a higher layer.
